List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on

(Ministries :  Development of North-Eastern Region; Disinvestment;

Total number of questions — 20
13
Increase in leprosy cases
*41. SHRI H.K. JAVARE GOWDA:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the number
of leprosy cases is increasing alarmingly
in the country;
(b) if so, the details of cases reported
in the past three years, State-wise;
(c) the steps taken for prevention/
eradication of leprosy in the country; and
(d) the details of the amount allocated
and spent for prevention/eradication of
leprosy in the State of Karnataka for the
past three years?
Child mortality rate
*42. SHRI AIMADUDDIN
AHMED KHAN (DURRU):
DR. KARAN SINGH:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether child mortality rate, as
per latest study, is the highest in
Maharashtra;
(b) if so, the comparative figures of
mortality rate in Maharashtra and other
States as per Census 2001;
(c) how the mortality rate has changed
over the decade 1991—2000 and the steps
taken to reduce the (IMR) infant mortality
rate during the period; and
(d) the targets fixed for the Ninth Plan
and the tentative targets for the Tenth Plan?
Fake tribal certificates
*43. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of TRIBAL AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that many non-
tribals are abusing the reservations by
producing fake ST certificates;
(b) if so, the action taken by his
Ministry to prevent the issuing of fake
tribal certificates;
(c) the details of the cases against those
who abused the reservation provisions,
State-wise; and
(d) how many people have, so far, been
removed from jobs for committing the
crime?

Downsizing of NCRPB
*44. SHRI RAMDAS AGARWAL:
Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT AND POVERTY
ALLEVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are
contemplating to downsize the National
Capital Region Planning Board (NCRPB)
and merge it with his Ministry;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) when was the Board formed, the
details of work done in the field of
housing, infrastructure development of
NCR, employment generation, transport
and telecom network indicating amount
sanctioned/spent by NCRPB during the
last five years; and
(d) whether Government are aware that
experts/planners of Delhi feel that
Government's decision would not only
hamper attempts to keep Capital's
population under control but will also
prevent urbanisation of its rural
pockets?
Disinvestment of PSUs
*45. SHRI PARMESHWAR KUMAR
AGARWALLA: Will the Minister of
DISINVESTMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the public sector
undertakings disinvested, privatized or
sold-off during the last three years;
(b) the factors taken into consideration
while putting an undertaking for
disinvestment or privatization;
(c) the manner in which the amount
realized has been utilized by Government
and the sectors in which the said amount
has been invested or utilized;
(d) the details of undertakings
proposed to be disinvested/privatized by
Government in near future or are under
consideration of Government; and
(e) the manner in which interests of
employees of these undertakings would
be safeguarded?
Improvement of National
Waterways-II
*46. DR. ARUN KUMAR SARMA:
Will the Minister of SHIPPING be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of the projects for
improvement of National Waterways-II
during the Ninth Five Year Plan, indicating
amount sanctioned, released and utilised,
target set and achievement made year-
wise; and
(b) the amount allocated for placement
of dredgers, number of dredgers placed
and the details of dredging activities in
National Waterways-II?
Publicity of Government views
*47. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY:
DR. Y. LAKSHMI PRASAD:
Will the Minister of INFORMATION
AND BROADCASTING be pleased to
state:
(a) the policy of Government in regard
to publicity of their views through audio-
visual media;
(b) whether it is a fact that owing to
lack of sponsorship, D.D. News Channel,
would be shut down; and
(c) if so, how the views of Government
would be publicised to fulfil social
responsibility?

Disinvestment of fertilizer
industries
311. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
Will the Minister of DISINVESTMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose
to disinvest some of the fertilizer
industries;
(b) if so, the details of such units;
(c) whether it will have some effect on
the farmers enjoying subsidies; and
(d) if so, the details thereof ?
Privatisation of Ashoka Beach Resort,
Kovalam, Kerala
312. SHRI C. O. POULOSE: Will the
Minister of DISINVESTMENT be pleased
to state:
(a) whether any decision has been taken
towards privatisation of Ashoka Beach
Resort at Kovalam, Kerala;
(b) if so, the details and the reasons
therefor;
(c) whether it is a fact that the year
1992 has been fixed for evaluating the
properties of ITDC;
(d) if so, the reasons therefor;
(e) whether Government have made any
assessment of the increase in the price of
real estate during 1992—2002; and
(f) if so, the details thereof?
PSUs under review for
disinvestment
313. SHRIMATI GURCHARAN
KAUR: Will the Minister of
DISINVESTMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the number of public sector
undertakings under review for
disinvestment, togetherwith details of the
present status of each; and
(b) the number of undertakings owned
by different States being brought under the
purview of privatisation during the next
financial year?

Achievement of target of disinvestment
314. SHRI J. CHITHARANJAN:
SHRI V. V. RAGHAVAN:
SHRI K. RAHMAN KHAN:
Will the Minister of
DISINVESTMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether the target fixed for
disinvestment of public sector undertakings
for the year 2001-2002 has been achieved;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the public sector undertakings chosen
for disinvestment during the year 2002-2003
and the target fixed for each of the units and
how much is expected to be generated
through disinvestment?
Disinvestment of MFIL
315. SHRI V. V. RAGHAVAN:
SHRI J. CHITHARANJAN:
Will the Minister of DISINVEST-
MENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are considering a proposal to off-load the
remaining 26 per cent Government stake in
the Modern Foods Industries Limited
(MFIL);
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is a fact that the BIFR to
which the company was referred last year
as a sick company has not announced its
verdict as yet; and
(d) if so, the reasons for delay?
Performance of disinvestment
316. SHRI J. CHITHARANJAN:
SHRI V. V. RAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of DISINVEST-
MENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government's
record in meeting disinvestment targets has
been dismal since it was launched in the
year 1991-92;
(b) if so, the target fixed every year and
the actual achievement since 1991-92;
(c) the reasons for failure to meet the
targets; and
(d) whether Government propose to
review the disinvestment policy being
followed so far in view of the dismal record
in meeting the targets?
Exclusion of Hotel Samrat from
disinvestment list
317. SHRI NANA DESHMUKH: Will
the Minister of DISINVESTMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have, of late,
decided to exclude Hotel Samrat from
disinvestment list;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) whether a part of the building would
be leased to house the offices of Intelligence
Bureau?
Disinvestment of VSNL
318. SHRI NILOTPAL BASU: Will the
Minister of DISINVESTMENT be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have disinvested their shares in VSNL;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the profits after tax and dividend paid
by the company during the last three years,
year-wise;
(d) the price range of VSNL shares
quoted in stock market during sale;
(e) the share prices of VSNL in
February-March, 2000;
